subject: Status: lt-en repro green, production-size comparison running
body:
Hi both,

Status. The lt-en repro is green: run.sh end-to-end (data download, formatting, training) worked once we were on Halima's container instead of the pinned cuda11 jaxlib wheels. On the tiny config, learning the optimizer hyperparameters via the tuning-loss gradient matched the hand-tuned baseline BLEU within 0.3, with zero search runs.

The production-size comparison kicked off Friday on 32 GPUs (Bruno's memory flag was right - the meta-gradient step pushed us past 24). Csilla's eval protocol: same token budget for both arms, where the baseline arm's budget includes its historical search cost. That is the fair fight the adoption decision should hinge on.

Risk: learned learning-rate schedules occasionally spike early in training on the big config - two of five seeds needed a restart. Kaia suspects the tuning-loss batch is too small; she is doubling it. If instability persists into May, the recommendation gets a stability caveat.

Rosa
